title: BAP LLM Call Inventory and Security Governance (BAP-914)
non_reliance_invariant: Security-critical authorization decisions cannot rely solely on untrusted LLM output. Deterministic Cedar policies and kernel sandbox boundaries strictly supersede AI recommendations.

calls.description: Translates raw developer prompt into standardized mission intent categories for CIO observability and governance context.
calls.model_name: Deterministic Edge AST Classifier / Gemini 1.5 Pro / Claude 3.5 Sonnet
calls.authorization_policy: Cedar Mission Telemetry Policy (Fail-Safe UNKNOWN, zero privilege elevation)
calls.governance_rule: Deterministic edge classifier executes locally; UNKNOWN intent fails safe and never permits escalated execution.

calls.description: Analyzes agent task goals and proposes minimum-necessary scoped permissions for execution.
calls.trust_boundary: Decision Plane & RFC 8693 STS Broker Boundary
calls.authorization_policy: Cedar Policy 1-7 Monotonic Attenuation & Anti-Escalation Gate
calls.governance_rule: AI permission plans are strictly advisory proposals. Cedar authorizer deterministically screens all proposals against forbid invariants.

calls.description: Inspects tool stdout/stderr and conversational messages for sensitive tokens, honeytokens, and prompt injection signatures.
calls.governance_rule: Deterministic regex and ambient environment scrubbing execute unconditionally in-kernel; model output cannot bypass redaction.
